schema_extraction_advice.pitfall: Existing-family label_ro may be a display arrow label,not a lexical form;node_id is often absent in favour of owner_id. V1.8 verified_forms may contain newly added forms only;do not label it a complete paradigm or blindly union planned_forms. One integrated V1.8 row is a relation,not a word/concept.

Some proposed_description fields contain stale bird prose on school-input rows. They were not installed owner descriptions. Prefer actual module/live-owner payload;never propose overwriting an old owner from this speculative field.
verified_links and reviewed_link_targets_before_drops may preserve pre-drop evidence. Use installation_links/final module for retained graph payload,not a union of every link-like field.

No verified_forms field exists. proposed_forms is the selected retained set only after filtering integrated rows and checking final module;planned_forms includes hypotheses/held context. REVIEW_ITEMS includes held rows.
qualified_forms also occurs on held records;state filtering is mandatory. Its old V1.13-only HTTP-count exception does not transfer to V1.14.

Partially applied branch through4f with modified serving fixtures,bundled content and a declined HTTP-count exception. Accepted source is not installed or landed;none of its54new node IDs are on latest main.

Nested secondary families can be held/excluded while the parent is accepted. Preserve explicit held/rejected family decisions;do not resurrect planned/observed fallback forms or certify a synonym from its candidate role.

Pool-level and record-level admitted_input_count/installed/source_applied remain0/false for source stock. Historical research summaries may still show pre-review accepted0;use final record state plus signed application chain for review readiness.

Final module hash legitimately differs from the reviewed original after exact signed edits. Verify the correction chain;do not demand an extra semantic review or collapse author source chronology into later peer evidence.

Stateless form/key/owner_fields rows in excluded_unqualified_form_checks are nonreserving identity_attention. Container-name inference alone caused a documented false held audio-family conclusion;real held lexical families still persist.

Resolve first checks the accent-preserving decomposed paște/paștele exceptions,then normalized index. Raw/current deferred dictionaries govern new admission history;they are not a blanket runtime rejection of already-landed leafă/ogradă. Preserve both policy observations without erasing existing live owners.
